commit_message: docs(submission): 8-slide deck, submission video end card and platform form text [TASK-044 TASK-045 TASK-046]
processing_description: Per the commit message at 9690361, the closing card (t >= 97 s, last 8 s) was re-rendered with judge-facing copy. The 0:00-1:37 portion of final.mp4 is visually the same content; the variant is a 105.000 s MP4 with a re-encoded end card. The variant no longer carries the literal 'Round 2 NOT submitted' line in its closing card; that honest-copy text remains in the source final.mp4 and in submission/round2/claims-check-report.txt. No audio is added; the source has no audio. The exact processing path used to produce the committed variant was not retained in the source checkout.
processing_path_for_committed_variant: UNKNOWN (processing source from 9690361 not preserved; the committed file is a pristine 1,037,598-byte MP4 with no script alongside it). The committed file is preserved unmodified and is the only file referenced by this variant provenance.

regeneration_target.binary_byte_identical_across_runs_reason: Byte identity across ffmpeg/libx264 versions is not guaranteed. Repeated local runs may be identical. The validation recipe checks format and labels; it does not reproduce the committed one-off variant byte-for-byte or copy its end-card design.

deterministic_regeneration.note: Deterministic-by-contract. The regenerated output is NOT byte-identical to the committed variant in general: ffmpeg with libx264 -crf 23 -preset medium is not bit-exact across runs, libx264 versions or host environments. The script proves the spec is reproducible: same 105.000 s, 1280x720, 30 fps, h264, silent, semantically-labelled regenerated end card. The committed variant above is preserved unmodified and is the only file referenced by this variant provenance.

claims_check_status: UNVERIFIED: this script's end-card text is not auto-OCR-inspected by the regenerate step or by verify-submission.mjs. The text is embedded by ffmpeg drawtext and rendered by libx264; honest-copy checks for slide decks and the storyboard are in submission/round2/scripts/claims_check.py.
